text:
jackie_ops: Heads-up — SeaLine sent a provisional ratecard for RMA forwarder on the H200 batch (12 units). Quote: $1.2k/unit for expedite air (incl. brokerage), $350/unit for consolidated air, sea option $90/unit but +30d lead time. serial mismatch flagged on 4 units. Any objections to moving forward with provisional PO?

maria_supply: hmm that's higher than expected for air. what's the SLA on depot repair? can we do partial air for the critical nodes? :thinking_face:

tom_forwarder: FYI SeaLine contact is @raul.seal (raul.sealine@example.com). They can consolidate to one AWB to waive the consolidation fee if we send all RMAs to their FRA hub. Quick AWB sample:```
AWB: SEALINE-789123
ETA FRA hub: 2024-05-12
HS code: 8473305000
Docs: commercial invoice + RMA manifest + serial list
```

alex_finance: we need a cost allocation plan. If we air-expedite for 3 critical units, finance will absorb expedite fees up to $4k total, anything above needs infra approval. Can procurement flag the PO accordingly?

sre-jen: we need 3 warm replacements in EU by next week — cluster health drops below 85% otherwise. The 4 serial-mismatch units: can we QA/flash locally or must they go to depot? if local flash possible, saves ~1.2k/unit.

procurement-bot: PO created (PO-67921). Line items: SeaLine forwarder fees (provisional). Lead time notes attached. Approver: @alex_finance.

maria_supply: Depot repair ETA from vendor-side: 10 business days after arrival to hub. If firmware mismatch -> additional QC hold (2-3 days) for preflight. So partial air for 3 + sea for rest seems reasonable. Need vendor to accept split AWB flow.

jackie_ops: Agreed on split. Plan: air-expedite 3 units (critical), consolidated air for the other 5 if possible, sea for remaining 4 (cheaper). Tom — can SeaLine do split routing on same manifest? Also need temporary pool handoff docs (we hand over 3 warm units to ops).

tom_forwarder: They can do split routing on same manifest but will require separate AWB numbers per route and a single master manifest. They need the serial reconciliation CSV before pickup. Also forwarder notes: for serial mismatch cases, they require a signed discrep doc from depot or vendor to release.

sre-jen: For the local flash option — @maria_supply can we get vendor firmware image + checksum so infra can attempt preflight here? If checksum matches and serial ties out, we can avoid full depot cycle for up to 2 units.

maria_supply: I can request firmware + checksums today. Vendor warned: no on-site warranty work without depot signoff, but they gave permission for a diagnostic flash under our temp-pool SOP if we provide logs. I'll push now.

alex_finance: tagging approve for PO-67921 up to $4k expedite. Anything beyond route to me with justification.

jackie_ops: Action items: @maria_supply confirm firmware/checksum request (EOD), @tom_forwarder confirm split-AWB capability + revised quote for split routing (by tomorrow 10:00), @sre-jen prepare list of 3 warm replacements and serials. I'll update incident slack if cluster degrades. :thumbsup:

procurement-bot: Noted. PO-67921 set to pending approval.

jackie_ops: thanks — will post AWB and manifest once tom confirms.
